quantile_method: linear over strictly positive model-val S4 margins; strict greater-than replacement
checkpoint_selection: scene-equal S4 zero-threshold regret; exact tie earliest step
local_eligibility: all three seeds model-val Net > 0 and gate-cal scene-equal Net > 0 and Damage <= .02; zero-support Damage NA
model_sequence: H0 regret+quantile first; if eligible skip H1/H2 and evaluate; otherwise H1; H2 only if H1 not eligible; never use dev AP to switch families
development_local_population: same original R0 native no-CD Top1 ID per frame; report bounded high/low candidate sample separately
normalization: reuse previous fit mean/std; no validation normalization
new_loss: mean six-action absolute squared error + mean five alternative delta squared error, coefficients 1
score_calibration: fit-only scene-equal weighted least squares; weights original top64=1/random64=15; float64 sigmoid(exp(alpha)*s+b); deterministic scipy L-BFGS-B; maxiter1000; no hyperparameter scan
C_initialization: a=1/fit score std; b=logit(weighted mean utility)-a*weighted mean score; std floor1e-6
transfer_frames: same fixed 32 dev_frames on old observed 12 scenes, only if development passes
